title: BMW Exposes The Secret Stash Of Cars It Hides In The US
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW's secret US vault, revealed by the Petersen Automotive Museum, contains rare and historic vehicles including the first Spartanburg-built car and a one-off Z3. The collection spans from a 1953 503 Coupe to modern M models, showcasing BMW's heritage.
car_models: 503 Coupe, M3 E36 Lightweight, Z3, M Coupe Clownshoe, ALPINA Z4, ALPINA Z8, 318i E36, X5 M, X6 M, 3.0 CSL, M3 E30, M5 E34, E60 M5, Z3 Coupe design study

title: Europe's 2027 Mazda CX-30 Has A Manual And Better Headlights Than Yours | Carscoops
author: Thanos Pappas
summary: Mazda has updated the 2027 CX-30 for Europe with new trims, improved safety tech, and matrix LED headlights, though the design remains largely unchanged. The Homura Plus trim adds premium features like a Bose sound system and 360-degree camera.

title: BMW Explains What It Takes To Develop An Electric M3
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW details the development challenges of its first electric M3, the ZA0, including new axles and a custom tire compound. The car will feature simulated engine noise and gear shifts, with a 2027 launch planned.

title: Texas Is About To Outsell California On New Cars, And Plenty Are Paying Cash | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Texas is rapidly closing the gap with California in new car sales, driven by strong demand for pickup trucks and a higher proportion of cash buyers. The shift may signal broader market trends as California's sedan preference fades.

title: California Wants To Regulate Fun Tires (Update)
author: Chris Rosales
summary: California is proposing regulations to mandate lower tire rolling resistance to reduce fuel consumption, which could ban high-performance track day tires from sale in the state. The California Energy Commission aims to set minimum efficiency standards based on original equipment tire performance.

title: Toyota's Fake Manual For EVs Might Be Too Real
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Toyota has filed a patent for a system that simulates an engine stall in an electric vehicle, using a fake manual gearbox with a clutch pedal to assess driver skills. The system can also activate safety systems based on the driver's skill level.

title: The E46 Beat the E36. Here's the Case For and Against
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: The E46 is declared the better car overall due to its superior chassis rigidity, interior, and S54 engine, though the E36 retains an edge in steering feel and unfiltered character.

title: BYD Builds Buses In California. The Pentagon Just Called It A Chinese Military Company | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: The Pentagon added BYD and Nio to its list of Chinese military companies, though BYD denies any military ties. The designation does not impose immediate sanctions but may deter US firms from doing business with them.

title: Toyota Chairman Akio Toyoda Waves Nissan Flags, Promotes Murano In Viral Video
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Toyota Chairman Akio Toyoda promotes the Nissan Murano in a viral video, encouraging Japanese customers to buy the American-made SUV. The gesture follows a trade agreement that allows U.S.-built vehicles to be sold in Japan without additional crash-testing.

title: Is BMW Bringing A New M Car To Le Mans This Weekend?
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW is expected to unveil a new electric M concept at the 24 Hours of Le Mans this weekend, likely a preview of the upcoming M3 ZA0 electric sports sedan. The mystery car, spotted at BMW M's booth, features wide fenders and double yellow lights consistent with an M-flavored i3.
car_models: M3 ZA0, i3, i3 M60, X5

title: Xiaomi’s New Nurburgring Record Didn’t Need A Driver, But Might Have Required A Sundial | Carscoops
author: Chris Chilton
summary: Xiaomi appears to have set an autonomous lap record at the Nürburgring with its YU7 GT SUV, though the exact time remains undisclosed and a photographer hinted it is slower than a human-driven lap. The achievement highlights Xiaomi's growing presence in EV performance and autonomous driving, but some question the value of a driverless record at the iconic track.

title: Toyota Veteran Reveals His Worst Fear: 'Everybody Is Shifting To EVs'
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Toyota chairman Akio Toyoda expresses fear and loneliness as the industry shifts toward EVs, while he continues to defend combustion engines and advocates for carbon-neutral fuels and hydrogen. Toyota remains the world's best-selling automaker but lags in the EV market, though it is now intensifying its electric efforts.

title: Akio Toyoda Admits His Biggest Fear Is An All-Electric Future | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Toyota chairman Akio Toyoda expresses fear and loneliness over the industry's shift to all-electric vehicles, emphasizing his commitment to internal combustion engines and alternative powertrains. He wants to continue building cars that enthusiasts love, including models like the GR GT with a twin-turbo V8.

title: BMW Invited 67 People To Test Its Armored Cars At Special Event
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW hosted 67 guests from eight European countries at its third annual Protection Driving Experience in Czechia to test its armored X5 Protection VR6 and 7 Series/i7 Protection vehicles. The event included back-to-back comparisons with standard models and driving demonstrations to showcase retained dynamics despite added armor weight.
car_models: X5 Protection VR6, 7 Series/i7 Protection, 740d, 750e, X5 40d, X5 50e, X5 M, M5 Touring, R 1250 RT

title: Audi's Mid-Size SUV Gets A Major Overhaul For 2027
author: Jeff Glucker
summary: The 2027 Audi Q7 receives a major overhaul with new adaptive lighting, upgraded interior materials, and powerful twin-turbo V6 and V8 engines. The third-generation model also introduces the more powerful SQ7 trim, delivering up to 591 horsepower.

title: Thousands Of Tires Appeared On His New Property And Nobody Will Claim Them | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: A Portland homeowner discovered thousands of illegally dumped tires on his newly purchased property, blocking access and triggering environmental investigations. Cleanup costs could leave him with a major financial burden.

title: Herbert Schnitzer, Who Built BMW's Greatest Race Team, Died At 85
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: Herbert Schnitzer, the last surviving Schnitzer brother and patriarch of BMW's most successful race team, died at 85 on his birthday. Under his leadership, the team won numerous championships across global series, including Le Mans in 1999, and nurtured legendary drivers.
car_models: BMW 1800 TISA, BMW 2000ti, BMW V12 LMR

title: Jeep Recalls 1.1 Million Vehicles That Might Catch Fire
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Jeep is recalling over 1 million Wrangler and Gladiator vehicles due to a fire risk caused by a faulty electrical connection in the power steering pump. Owners are advised to park outside until repairs are completed.

title: Eight $290K Bentleys Left The Factory With The Wrong Driveshaft | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: Bentley is recalling eight 2026 Continental GT and GTC models due to incorrect driveshafts that can loosen over time, causing noise and vibration. The issue stems from a supplier that moved locations and used the wrong component, though no accidents have been reported.

title: One Of America's Favorite Sedans Just Hit A Major Milestone
author: Jeff Glucker
summary: Honda has sold over 15 million Accords in the US since the model's launch in 1976, with more than 13 million built at its Ohio factory. The article celebrates the Accord's 50th anniversary and discusses its history and future design evolution.

title: There Were Only 356 E36 M3 GTs. Here's Why It Beats the Lightweight
author: Horatiu Boeriu
summary: The E36 M3 GT, a homologation special built for IMSA racing with only 356 units made, is argued to be the definitive E36 M3 over the US-market Lightweight due to its factory motorsport hardware and road car usability. Values have climbed from around €50,000 to nearly six figures at auction.
car_models: E36 M3 GT, E36 M3 Lightweight, E30 M3, E36 M3 GTR

title: AI Cameras Fined Empty Seats For Not Wearing Seatbelts | Carscoops
author: Thanos Pappas
summary: AI traffic cameras in Athens failed during a pilot program, generating 13,000 citations but only 400 were validated by human reviewers. The system struggled with false positives, mistaking objects like vapes and empty seats for seatbelt and phone violations.

title: Porsche Turned Toy Story Characters Into Real Cars—And They're Incredible
author: Jeff Perez
summary: Porsche and Pixar created three custom 911s inspired by Toy Story characters Woody, Jessie, and Buzz Lightyear ahead of Toy Story 5. Each car features hundreds of hours of hand-painted details, custom interiors, and character-specific design elements.
car_models: 911 Carrera T, 911 GT3 RS, Targa 4 GTS

title: Gran Turismo 7's June Update Hands You BMW And Ferrari Racers For Free | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: Gran Turismo 7's free June update adds four modern Le Mans Hypercars and a new safety car, along with new races and a Scapes location. The update significantly expands the game's modern Gr.1 prototype roster.
car_models: BMW M Hybrid V8, Ferrari 499P, Peugeot 9X8, Porsche 963, Porsche 911 Turbo S Safety Car

title: We drove the 717-hp BMW M5 Touring from South Carolina to Key West
author: Stefan Grundhoff
summary: The BMW M5 Touring PHEV, weighing 5,500 lbs and producing 727 hp, is the heaviest and most powerful M5 wagon ever, costing $140,775 as tested. Despite 40 miles of electric range, the V8 engine is the main attraction, and the car is a bestseller in the US, a country that favors large, powerful vehicles.

title: Mitsubishi's New EV Looks Awfully Familiar
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Mitsubishi is launching the 2027 Eclipse Sportback, an electric vehicle based on the new Nissan Leaf with unique styling changes. The car will go on sale in the second half of the year, with specs and pricing expected to mirror the Leaf.
car_models: Eclipse Sportback, Nissan Leaf, Eclipse Cross

title: Aston Martin Cranks The Vantage Up To 11 With New Hardcore Variant | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Aston Martin is developing a hardcore Vantage variant, potentially called the RS or AMR, with aerodynamic upgrades and a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8 producing over 670 hp. A production-ready prototype has been spotted at the Nürburgring featuring a revised exhaust, larger rear wing, and upgraded brakes.
car_models: Vantage, Vantage S, Vantage AMR, Vantage RS

title: The New Audi Q7 Brings The Fight To BMW's Next X5
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Audi has unveiled the third-generation 2027 Q7, featuring a new PPC architecture and split headlights, while offering different engines for Europe and America. The SUV keeps three-row seating and adds optional automatic doors to compete with the upcoming BMW X5.
car_models: Audi Q7, BMW X5, Audi Q9, Audi Q5, BMW X7

title: Toyota Engineered A $470 Skid Plate That Steadies The Old Hilux In Crosswinds | Carscoops
author: Thanos Pappas
summary: Toyota's Upgrade Factory has released a $470 aluminum skid plate with aerodynamic fins for the previous-generation Hilux, designed to reduce crosswind sensitivity and improve stability by smoothing underbody airflow. The part, developed at Toyota's Shibetsu Proving Ground, cuts low-frequency vibrations to one-tenth of original levels without compromising ground clearance or oil change access.

title: Used EV Prices Are Rising Faster Than Gas Cars
author: Jeff Glucker
summary: Used EV wholesale prices are rising nearly 12% year over year, outpacing gas cars' 3% growth, driven by high fuel costs. However, a pending surge in off-lease supply is expected to create market volatility later this year.
car_models: Tesla Model 3, Tesla Model Y, Ford Mustang Mach-E, Chevrolet Bolt, Hyundai Ioniq 5

title: Lincoln's Latest Marketing Stunt Looks Like An Ultra-Luxury Porta Potty | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Lincoln has introduced a futuristic relaxation pod called 'The Sanctuary: By Lincoln Rejuvenate' to promote its brand, but critics compare it to an ultra-luxury porta potty. The pod features a Navigator seat, scent diffuser, and panoramic display, though Lincoln sales are struggling after discontinuing the Corsair.

title: The Ultimate Self-Driving Machine: BMW Owners Logged 200 Million Hands-Free Kilometers
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW reports that its Highway Assistant hands-free driving system has accumulated 200 million kilometers (125 million miles) from owners, and the latest version will expand to over 20 European countries. The system is SAE Level 2 certified and includes a City Assistant for traffic light detection and automatic stopping.

title: Audi Has A Good Reason Why Europe's New Q7 Is Diesel-Only (For Now)
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Audi's third-generation Q7 launches in Europe exclusively with a turbodiesel 3.0-liter V6, prioritizing expected customer demand despite diesel's declining popularity. Gasoline V6 and plug-in hybrid options will be added in Europe between late 2026 and early 2027.

title: New Audi Q7 vs BMW X5 Photo Comparison Shows Why the Next X5 Matters
author: Steven Paul
summary: The new Audi Q7 has been significantly updated with modern styling, a screen-heavy interior, and advanced tech, making the current BMW X5 look dated. This comparison highlights the pressure on BMW to deliver a major leap with the next-generation X5.

title: Most 780-HP Sedans Make You Take An Automatic, This Cadillac Doesn't | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: Callaway has introduced the CT5-V Blackwing SC780, a tuned version of Cadillac's super sedan that boosts output to 780 horsepower using a larger 3.0-liter supercharger. The upgrade is available for both manual and automatic transmissions, offering enthusiasts a rare high-power sedan with a stick shift.

title: The New Audi Q7 Projects Turn Signals Onto The Road
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Audi's third-generation Q7 introduces advanced turn signals that project stylized arrows onto the road at night, improving safety for nearby vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians. The feature is integrated into both headlights and taillights, with the rear using OLED technology for customizable light signatures.
car_models: Audi Q7, Audi R8 LMX, BMW i8

title: 2026 BMW iX3 Visits Sunny Lisbon For New Photo Shoot
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: The 2026 BMW iX3 is off to a strong start with over 50,000 orders and a 171% sales increase in Europe, while expanding production and adding new options. The electric SUV is already outselling its combustion-engine sibling, with deliveries in North America set to begin in September.

title: Ford's Answer To The Jeep Wrangler 392? Surrender | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: Ford has downplayed the possibility of a Bronco Raptor R or Ranger Raptor R, with an official suggesting the Ranger Raptor may already have too much power. This leaves the Jeep Wrangler 392 as the dominant high-performance off-roader in its segment.
car_models: Bronco, Bronco Raptor, Bronco Raptor R, Ranger Raptor, Ranger Raptor R, Jeep Wrangler 392, Jeep Wrangler Moab 392, Chevrolet Colorado, GMC Canyon, Nissan Frontier, Toyota Tacoma, Jeep Gladiator, Dodge Dakota, Dodge 1500 Rumble Bee, Dodge TRX
brands: Ford, Jeep, Chevrolet, GMC, Nissan, Toyota, Dodge

title: Honda's CEO Survived A Revolt After The Automaker's Worst Year In Decades: Report
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe survived an attempted ousting by former executives after the company reported its first annual loss in nearly 70 years. The revolt was driven by dissatisfaction with Honda's performance in China and Mibe's priorities, leading to a 30% pay cut for the CEO.
car_models: Odyssey, HR-V, Accord, Honda 0 Series SUV Concept

title: BMW M3 With Individual Colors Finally Arrives In Brazil
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW has finally introduced Individual colors for the M3 G80 in Brazil, offering up to 150 special hues with the first batch featuring eye-catching shades like Java Green and Techno Violet. The M3 is sold exclusively as a rear-wheel-drive Competition model with automatic transmission, priced from R$ 894,950.

title: A New York County Ticketed Over 18,000 Drivers Blowing Past Its Stopped School Buses | Carscoops
author: Stephen Rivers
summary: Monroe County, New York has issued over 18,000 citations since late 2023 for drivers illegally passing stopped school buses, with one driver even using a sidewalk to bypass a bus. The enforcement program raises questions about safety, deterrence, and revenue generation.

title: No, This Isn't The C9 Corvette
author: Jeff Perez
summary: Images circulating online claiming to show the next-generation C9 Corvette were actually of the CX Concept, as confirmed by Chevrolet. The confusion arose from a brief shot in an NBC News interview with GM CEO Mary Barra.
car_models: Corvette C9, Corvette C8, Grand Sport, Corvette CX Concept

title: BMW’s Electric M3 Is Learning From V10s, Inline-Sixes, and the Nürburgring
author: Steven Paul
summary: BMW M is developing the electric M3's sound by blending recordings from iconic V10, V8, and inline-six engines, while also conducting extensive Nürburgring testing. The goal is to create an emotional yet functional sound that provides accurate acceleration feedback without being overdone.
car_models: E92 M3 GTS, F82 M4 GTS, E63 M6, M3 (ZA0)

title: ORA 7 Looks Like A Beetle Got Knocked Up By A Porsche | Carscoops
author: Michael Gauthier
summary: The ORA 7, revealed by Chinese officials, mixes Porsche and Volkswagen styling cues and is offered as both a wagon and sedan with two electric motor options. The EV features a lithium iron phosphate battery and outputs of 201 hp and 215 hp.
car_models: ORA 7, Porsche Cayenne, Porsche Panamera, Volkswagen Beetle
brands: ORA, Great Wall Motor, Porsche, Volkswagen

title: New BMW 7 Series Strikes A Pose With Matte Silver Paint
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: BMW UK showcases the facelifted i7 60 xDrive with M Sport Package and Individual Frozen Space Silver matte paint, featuring 21-inch M Aero cross-spoke wheels. The 7 Series LCI enters production next month with over 500 color options.
car_models: BMW 7 Series, i7 60 xDrive, i7 M70, iX3

title: Ford's New $30,000 Truck Was Caught Testing—And It's Tiny
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Ford's new electric pickup, spotted testing in California, is notably smaller than the F-150 and resembles the Maverick, with a highly aerodynamic shape. The truck is expected to be priced around $30,000 and offer more passenger space than a Toyota RAV4.

title: A 1-Of-765 McLaren Died In A Michigan Fire, And Bidders Smell A Deal | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: A rare McLaren 765LT Spider was destroyed in a fire in Michigan and is now up for auction on Copart, with bidding already in five figures. The car's rear end is heavily damaged, but its scarcity and salvageable parts make it attractive to bidders.

title: Toyota Is Quietly Building A Mid-Engined, All-Wheel-Drive Sports Car
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Toyota is developing a new mid-engine, all-wheel-drive sports car as a spiritual successor to the MR2, expected in four to five years. The car will likely feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine with over 400 horsepower and an eight-speed automatic gearbox.
car_models: MR2, FT-Se Concept, Concept M, GR Corolla, GR Yaris

title: BYD Boss Says Company Will Outsell Toyota Within Five Years | Carscoops
author: Brad Anderson
summary: BYD chairman Wang Chuanfu claims the company will become the world's largest automaker within five years, outselling Toyota and Volkswagen. To achieve this, BYD must increase sales by 1 million units annually, despite a recent sales decline in China.
brands: BYD, Toyota, Volkswagen, Ford, Lexus, Daihatsu

title: Don't Worry, Porsche's Iconic Sports Car Won't Go Electric
author: Anthony Alaniz
summary: Porsche CEO Michael Leiters confirmed the 911 will not go fully electric, continuing with combustion and hybrid powertrains instead. The automaker will focus on offering EVs that consumers want, like the Macan, while preserving the 911's iconic driving experience.

title: Nissan Recalls Over 50,000 SUVs For Blank Screens
author: Jeff Glucker
summary: Nissan is recalling over 50,000 Kicks from the 2025 and 2026 model years due to blank driver display screens on startup. Affected owners will receive letters starting July 1st and can get a free 30-minute fix.

title: Mazda Found A Problem With Rival Hybrids. Its Own System Claims To Fix It
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Mazda's CX-5 project manager criticizes rival hybrids for poor throttle response, and the company claims its in-house hybrid system, debuting in 2027 with the Skyactiv-Z engine, will fix this issue. The new hybrid aims to combine efficiency with performance by using an electric motor to compensate for the gasoline engine's low-rpm shortcomings.

title: Porsche Reflects On Its First Electric Car: 'Timing Wasn't Ideal'
author: Adrian Padeanu
summary: Porsche CEO Michael Leiters believes the Taycan was launched too early for the market to fully appreciate it, as sales have declined significantly in recent years. Despite this, Porsche will continue investing in EVs while maintaining gas engines and hybrids.
brands: Porsche, Volkswagen Group, Audi, Mercedes, BMW
